post.description:
Check the account against ``identity.users`` and start a 12 h session (cookie).

After ``login_max_failures`` failed attempts from one address within ``login_window_s``, further attempts are
refused with 429 and ``Retry-After`` until the oldest failure leaves the window.
End the session: its token id is refused until it would have expired, and the cookie is removed.

get.description: The signed-in user and the end of the session; 401 without a valid session.
The process answers. Data-source checks are in ``/api/health/deep`` (#317).
Jobs of the last 7 days, newest first.

post.description: Queue a job. A request equal to a queued or running job (same kind and parameters) returns that job.
A queued job is not started; a running job is stopped. Both end with status ``cancelled``.

get.description:
Events as they are published, a heartbeat every 15 s, and after a reconnect with ``Last-Event-ID`` (header, or
the ``last_event_id`` parameter) the events that were missed (at most the last 100). The stream ends when the
session ends; the browser then reconnects and receives 401.

parameters.description: Resume after this event id when the client opens a new connection (an EventSource cannot set headers); the Last-Event-ID header of the browser's own reconnect takes precedence
parameters.name: last_event_id

schema.description: Resume after this event id when the client opens a new connection (an EventSource cannot set headers); the Last-Event-ID header of the browser's own reconnect takes precedence
schema.title: Last Event Id

get.description: The last ``limit`` events of the stream, oldest first (heartbeats are not stored).
